conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: The Federal Register disposition note records that EO 11294 was superseded in part by EO 11609 of July 22, 1971 and revoked by EO 12561 of July 1, 1986. Reading section 11 of EO 11609 in the held text shows that the partial supersession reaches only Section 3 of EO 11294 (the amendment of EO 11230), and section 3 of EO 12561 revokes the whole order. The partial change therefore ends one clause in 1971 and does not keep any clause alive: sections 1, 2 and 4 ended with the whole-order revocation of July 1, 1986.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 11294 (August 4, 1966, 31 FR 10601) was expressly revoked in full by section 3 of Executive Order 12561 of July 1, 1986 (51 FR 24299), whose text was read; the Federal Register disposition note (it records the revocation by EO 12561 of July 1, 1986), the 1989 codification row (revoked) and the held U.S. Code note under 3 U.S.C. 301 all agree. Section 3 of EO 11294 had earlier been superseded in part by section 11 of EO 11609 (July 22, 1971), which does not reach the other sections. Nothing in the held sources shows revival after 1986, and the order had no force on 2026-10-14. Recommended: no.
